name: 7-chloro-AMT
summary: 7-Chloro-α-methyltryptamine (7-Cl-AMT) is a tryptamine derivative with stimulant effects, invented in the 1960s. It is a weak monoamine oxidase inhibitor but its pharmacology has not otherwise been studied by modern techniques, though several closely related compounds are known to act as serotonin–dopamine releasing agents and agonists of the 5-HT2A receptor.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It blocks monoamine oxidase weakly, which can raise the risk of serotonin syndrome and of rises in blood pressure. Related α-alkyltryptamines can cause nausea, muscle tension, a racing heart, overheating and anxiety.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它會輕微抑制單胺氧化酶，可能提高血清素症候群與血壓升高的風險。相關的α-烷基色胺類可能引起噁心、肌肉緊繃、心跳急促、體溫過高與焦慮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它会轻微抑制单胺氧化酶，可能提高血清素症候群与血压升高的风险。相关的α-烷基色胺类可能引起恶心、肌肉紧绷、心跳急促、体温过高与焦虑。

fact.en: It was invented in the 1960s, and its chlorine sits at the 7 position, right next to the ring nitrogen of the indole, a crowded spot few tryptamines use.
fact.zh: 它於1960年代被合成，氯位於第7位，就緊鄰吲哚環上的氮，那是個擁擠的位置，很少有色胺會用到。
fact.zhHans: 它于1960年代被合成，氯位于第7位，就紧邻吲哚环上的氮，那是个拥挤的位置，很少有色胺会用到。
